# NeuronalAvalanche

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A cascade of spiking activity across a neural network, with sizes and durations following power-law distributions, indicative of critical dynamics. Serves as a key metric for validating and tuning in-network neuromorphic systems to emulate brain-like efficient processing and fault tolerance.
